why: lane B's virtual clock. later: the fired callback sends y for x, witnessed after the call. armClear: a timer armed and cleared is nothing, the candidate without it is equal (PASS-bounded; lane A sees a transition and cannot prove it). ordered: two timers armed in the other order fire in due order, the same trace. everyTick: a different interval is a different pending record, witnessed. chain: a timer arming a timer runs both, untouched and proved. frame: an idle callback for an animation frame is a different pending kind, witnessed. clearForeign: a handle the run did not arm (an argument here, a field in real code) is cleared as a request to the world; the candidate that drops the clear is witnessed on the trace, since the outside world keeps the timer.
